Requirement Elicitation, BRD / FRD Documentation Stakeholder Management, UAT, Defect Tracking OTC Trade Lifecycle, Regulatory Reporting Data Mapping, Reconciliation, Process Automation Agile / Scrum, User Stories, Backlog Grooming

SQL (Oracle SQL, SQL Server) Market EDM (MEDM) OMNIUM OTC Trade Capture Microsoft ADO, ServiceNow SFTP & Data Integration Systems
